cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'd have gone without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'd have gone without me.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're circling the station. I avoid my old office too. Why this route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My former boss catches this train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told mine I'd become a novelist. What did you tell yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That I had a better offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've carried the same blank notebook past mine for a year. Are you avoiding him because there wasn't a better offer?

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Don't open the delivery email. Let me deduce where our office biscuits went.

beats.text: Reception signed for them. I'll tell everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too late. They're downstairs opening the box.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. We've filtered out everyone who wasn't committed to dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.
